units.text: The launch of SPHEREx and PUNCH occurred from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, not Kennedy Space Center.

citations.title: NASA SVS | PUNCH Spacecraft Beauty Passes

judgement.reason: The passages state the missions launched from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, which directly supports that it was not from Kennedy Space Center.

units.text: NASA and SpaceX had initially targeted March 4, 2025, for the launch of SPHEREx and PUNCH missions.

citations.title: NASA, SpaceX Update Launch Date for SPHEREx, PUNCH Mission - NASA Science

judgement.reason: The passage states NASA and SpaceX were targeting no earlier than March 4, 2025, but does not support that this date was the initial target.
